Function Description: Returns an unmodifiable view of the HTTP headers and corresponding values.

Modification Discription: Deprecated the ``HTTPResponse.getheaders()`` and ``HTTPResponse.getheader()`` methods.
Function Description: Returns the value of header for the response.

Modification Discription: Removed deprecated getheaders() calls in contrib module. Fixed the type hint of ``PoolKey.key_retries`` by adding ``bool`` to the union. (`#2865 <https://github.com/urllib3/urllib3/issues/2865>`__)
Remove "!" character from the unreserved characters in IPv6 Zone ID parsing

Removed fallback on certificate ``commonName`` in ``match_hostname()`` function.
  This behavior was deprecated in May 2000 in RFC 2818. Instead only ``subjectAltName``
  is used to verify the hostname by default. To enable verifying the hostname against
  ``commonName`` use ``SSLContext.hostname_checks_common_name = True``
Function Description:
Verify that cert (in decoded format as returned by SSLSocket.getpeercert()) matches the hostname. RFC 2818 and RFC 6125 rules are followed, but IP addresses are not accepted for hostname.
CertificateError is raised on failure. On success, the function returns nothing.

Modification Discription: Removed ``urllib3.contrib.appengine.AppEngineManager`` and support for Google App Engine Standard Environment.
Function Description: Connection manager for Google App Engine sandbox applications.

Modification Discription: Removed ``urllib3.HTTPResponse.from_httplib``
Function Description: Given an http.client.HTTPResponse instance r, return a corresponding urllib3.response.HTTPResponse object.

Modification Discription: * Removed default value of ``None`` for the ``request_context`` parameter of ``urllib3.PoolManager.connection_from_pool_key``. This change should have no effect on users as the default value of ``None`` was an invalid option and was never used
Function Description: Get a urllib3.connectionpool.ConnectionPool based on the provided pool key.

Modification Discription:
Removed the ``urllib3.request`` module. ``urllib3.request.RequestMethods`` has been made a private API.
  This change was made to ensure that ``from urllib3 import request`` imported the top-level ``request()``
  function instead of the ``urllib3.request`` module
Function Description: A convenience, top-level request method. It uses a module-global PoolManager instance. Therefore, its side effects could be shared across dependencies relying on it. To avoid side effects create a new PoolManager instance and use it instead. The method does not accept low-level **urlopen_kw keyword arguments.

Modification Discription: Removed support for SSLv3.0 from the ``urllib3.contrib.pyopenssl`` even when support is available from the compiled OpenSSL library
Function Description: Module for using pyOpenSSL as a TLS backend.

Modification Discription: Removed the deprecated ``urllib3.contrib.ntlmpool`` module.
Function Description: NTLM authenticating pool, contributed by erikcederstran

Modification Discription: Removed ``DEFAULT_CIPHERS``, ``HAS_SNI``, ``USE_DEFAULT_SSLCONTEXT_CIPHERS``, from the private module ``urllib3.util.ssl_``.
Removed ``DEFAULT_CIPHERS``, ``HAS_SNI``, ``USE_DEFAULT_SSLCONTEXT_CIPHERS``, from the private module ``urllib3.util.ssl_``.
Removed ``DEFAULT_CIPHERS``, ``HAS_SNI``, ``USE_DEFAULT_SSLCONTEXT_CIPHERS``, from the private module ``urllib3.util.ssl_``.
Removed ``urllib3.exceptions.SNIMissingWarning``
Function Description: Warned when making a HTTPS request without SNI available.

Modification Discription: Removed the ``_prepare_conn`` method from ``HTTPConnectionPool``. Previously this was only used to call ``HTTPSConnection.set_cert()`` by ``HTTPSConnectionPool``
* Removed ``tls_in_tls_required`` property from ``HTTPSConnection``. This is now determined from the ``scheme`` parameter in ``HTTPConnection.set_tunnel()``.
* Removed the ``strict`` parameter/attribute from ``HTTPConnection``, ``HTTPSConnection``, ``HTTPConnectionPool``, ``HTTPSConnectionPool``, and ``HTTPResponse``.

Deprecated ``HTTPResponse.getheaders()`` and ``HTTPResponse.getheader()`` which will be removed in urllib3 v2.1.0. Instead use ``HTTPResponse.headers`` and ``HTTPResponse.headers.get(name, default)``.
Function Description: Returns an unmodifiable view of the HTTP headers and corresponding values.

Modification Discription: Deprecated ``HTTPResponse.getheaders()`` and ``HTTPResponse.getheader()`` which will be removed in urllib3 v2.1.0. Instead use ``HTTPResponse.headers`` and ``HTTPResponse.headers.get(name, default)``.
Function Description: Returns the value of header for the response.

Modification Discription: Deprecated ``urllib3.contrib.pyopenssl`` module which will be removed in urllib3 v2.1.0.
Function Description: Module for using pyOpenSSL as a TLS backend.

Modification Discription: Deprecated ``urllib3.contrib.securetransport`` module which will be removed in urllib3 v2.1.0.
Function Description: This makes platform-native TLS available to urllib3 users on macOS without the use of a compiler.

Modification Discription: Deprecated ``ssl_version`` option in favor of ``ssl_minimum_version``. ``ssl_version`` will be removed in urllib3 v2.1.0.
Function Description: Supported SSL versions at the server configuration parameter

Modification Discription: Deprecated the ``strict`` parameter of ``PoolManager.connection_from_context()`` as it's not longer needed in Python 3.x. It will be removed in urllib3 v2.1.0
Deprecated the ``NewConnectionError.pool`` attribute which will be removed in urllib3 v2.1.0.
Deprecated ``format_header_param_html5`` and ``format_header_param`` in favor of ``format_multipart_header_param``.
Deprecated ``format_header_param_html5`` and ``format_header_param`` in favor of ``format_multipart_header_param`` (`#2257 <https://github.com/urllib3/urllib3/issues/2257>`__).
Deprecated ``RequestField.header_formatter`` parameter which will be removed in urllib3 v2.1.0.
Deprecated ``HTTPSConnection.set_cert()`` method. Instead pass parameters to the ``HTTPSConnection`` constructor.
* Deprecated ``HTTPConnection.request_chunked()`` method which will be removed in urllib3 v2.1.0. Instead pass ``chunked=True`` to ``HTTPConnection.request()``.
Function Description: Alternative to the common request method, which sends the body with chunked encoding and not as one block

Modification Discription: Changed ``urllib3.HTTPConnection.getresponse`` to return an instance of ``urllib3.HTTPResponse`` instead of ``http.client.HTTPResponse``.
Function Description: Get the response from the server.

Modification Discription:
Changed ``ssl_version`` to instead set the corresponding ``SSLContext.minimum_version``
  and ``SSLContext.maximum_version`` values.  Regardless of ``ssl_version`` passed
  ``SSLContext`` objects are now constructed using ``ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_CLIENT``.
Function Description: Supported SSL versions at the server configuration parameter

Modification Discription: Changed default ``SSLContext.minimum_version`` to be ``TLSVersion.TLSv1_2`` in line with Python 3.10.
Function Description: Like SSLContext.maximum_version except it is the lowest supported version or TLSVersion.MINIMUM_SUPPORTED.

Modification Discription: Changed ``ProxyError`` to wrap any connection error (timeout, TLS, DNS) that occurs when connecting to the proxy.
Changed ``urllib3.util.create_urllib3_context`` to not override the system cipher suites with a default value. The new default will be cipher suites configured by the operating system.
Function Description: Creates and configures an ssl.SSLContext instance for use with urllib3.

Modification Discription: Changed ``multipart/form-data`` header parameter formatting matches the WHATWG HTML Standard as of 2021-06-10. Control characters in filenames are no longer percent encoded.
Changed the error raised when connecting via HTTPS when the ``ssl`` module isn't available from ``SSLError`` to ``ImportError``.
Function Description: This module provides access to Transport Layer Security (often known as “Secure Sockets Layer”) encryption and peer authentication facilities for network sockets, both client-side and server-side. This module uses the OpenSSL library. It is available on all modern Unix systems, Windows, macOS, and probably additional platforms, as long as OpenSSL is installed on that platform.

Modification Discription: Changed ``HTTPConnection.request()`` to always use lowercase chunk boundaries when sending requests with ``Transfer-Encoding: chunked``.
Function Description: This will send a request to the server using the HTTP request method method and the request URI url. The provided url must be an absolute path to conform with RFC 2616 §5.1.2 (unless connecting to an HTTP proxy server or using the OPTIONS or CONNECT methods)

Modification Discription: Changed ``enforce_content_length`` default to True, preventing silent data loss when reading streamed responses.
Function Description: Enforce content length checking. Body returned by server must match value of Content-Length header, if present. Otherwise, raise error.

Modification Discription: Changed internal implementation of ``HTTPHeaderDict`` to use ``dict`` instead of ``collections.OrderedDict`` for better performance
Changed the ``urllib3.contrib.pyopenssl`` module to wrap ``OpenSSL.SSL.Error`` with ``ssl.SSLError`` in ``PyOpenSSLContext.load_cert_chain``.
Function Description: Module for using pyOpenSSL as a TLS backend. This module was relevant before the standard library ssl module supported SNI, but now that we’ve dropped support for Python 2.7 all relevant Python versions support SNI so this module is no longer recommended.

Modification Discription: Changed usage of the deprecated ``socket.error`` to ``OSError``.
Function Description: Errors are written to the agent log file for problems that occur with data received from a socket client.

Modification Discription: Changed all parameters in the ``HTTPConnection`` and ``HTTPSConnection`` constructors to be keyword-only except ``host`` and ``port``.
Function Description: An HTTPConnection instance represents one transaction with an HTTP server. It should be instantiated by passing it a host and optional port number. If no port number is passed, the port is extracted from the host string if it has the form host:port, else the default HTTP port (80) is used. If the optional timeout parameter is given, blocking operations (like connection attempts) will timeout after that many seconds (if it is not given, the global default timeout setting is used). The optional source_address parameter may be a tuple of a (host, port) to use as the source address the HTTP connection is made from. The optional blocksize parameter sets the buffer size in bytes for sending a file-like message body.

Modification Discription: Changed all parameters in the ``HTTPConnection`` and ``HTTPSConnection`` constructors to be keyword-only except ``host`` and ``port``.
Function Description: A subclass of HTTPConnection that uses SSL for communication with secure servers. Default port is 443. If context is specified, it must be a ssl.SSLContext instance describing the various SSL options.

Modification Discription: Changed ``HTTPConnection.getresponse()`` to set the socket timeout from ``HTTPConnection.timeout`` value before reading data from the socket. This previously was done manually by the ``HTTPConnectionPool`` calling ``HTTPConnection.sock.settimeout(...)``.
Function Description: Should be called after a request is sent to get the response from the server. Returns an HTTPResponse instance.

Modification Discription: Changed the ``_proxy_host`` property to ``_tunnel_host`` in ``HTTPConnectionPool`` to more closely match how the property is used (value in ``HTTPConnection.set_tunnel()``).
Function Description: name and port of a proxied server as specified in the proxy_pass directive;

Modification Discription: Changed name of ``Retry.BACK0FF_MAX`` to be ``Retry.DEFAULT_BACKOFF_MAX``.
Changed TLS handshakes to use ``SSLContext.check_hostname`` when possible.
Function Description: Whether to match the peer cert’s hostname in SSLSocket.do_handshake(). The context’s verify_mode must be set to CERT_OPTIONAL or CERT_REQUIRED, and you must pass server_hostname to wrap_socket() in order to match the hostname. Enabling hostname checking automatically sets verify_mode from CERT_NONE to CERT_REQUIRED. It cannot be set back to CERT_NONE as long as hostname checking is enabled. The PROTOCOL_TLS_CLIENT protocol enables hostname checking by default. With other protocols, hostname checking must be enabled explicitly.

Modification Discription: Changed ``server_hostname`` to behave like other parameters only used by ``HTTPSConnectionPool``。
Function Description: Hostname of the server: str type, or None for server-side socket or if the hostname was not specified in the constructor.

Modification Discription: Changed ``HTTPResponse.read()`` to raise an error when calling with ``decode_content=False`` after using ``decode_content=True`` to prevent data loss.
Function Description: Reads and returns the response body, or up to the next amt bytes.
